text: Across forty DAOs in eight segments the unweighted dataset mean is 67.3 of 130 points (51.8 percent): the median DAO has implemented roughly half of the institutional architecture the framework prescribes.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6819121

abstract: The unweighted dataset mean total of 67.3 of 130 (51.8 percent) is the central quantitative finding: the median DAO has implemented roughly half of what the framework prescribes.
